bundle.shortDescription: Local completion tracker for The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ — by reiassezbeau (github.com/reiassezbeau).
bundle.longDescription: Isaac Completion Tracker — a local desktop app that reads your The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ save to track your 641 achievements and your per-character completion marks, and to chart your route to Dead God. It works with the network unplugged; the only request it ever makes is the update check you trigger yourself. Created by reiassezbeau (https://github.com/reiassezbeau). A community tool, not affiliated with Nicalis or Edmund McMillen.
